verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms that docs.manufact.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the Manufact Cloud docs. The docs pages are also served as raw .md URLs (e.g. /dashboard/servers.md, /cli.md), which gives an agent machine-readable documentation to work from. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no first-party documentation explaining how to point agents at these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
